sections.label: Haze long-term health data
sections.summary: No local or international data exists on long-term health effects of short-term episodic haze exposure, and researching it would be highly challenging.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Health (a) whether he can provide data on the long-term impact of Singaporean children's exposure to haze in terms of the likelihood of developing respiratory illnesses, including chronic conditions such as asthma, later in life; and (b) what is the estimated healthcare cost of this impact.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: There is currently no data both locally or internationally, that looks into the long-term health effect of short-term, episodic exposure to the haze.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Researching this would be highly challenging as any results would be based on observational studies only which would not be able to show a definite cause-and-effect relationship.

sections.label: Overseas long-term exposure studies
sections.summary: Overseas studies on continuous long-term air pollutant exposure over several years showed lung function abnormalities in children and later adulthood.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: However, overseas studies on long-term health impact have been based on long-term exposures, which are different from the pattern of exposure here.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These studies showed that continuous, long-term exposure to air pollutants over several years may result in lung function abnormalities in children and subsequently, in adulthood.

sections.label: Haze Subsidy Scheme
sections.summary: The Haze Subsidy Scheme assists children, the elderly and lower- to middle-income Singaporeans with outpatient haze-related treatments, with over $3.3 million in 2015 subsidies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: First, the Haze Subsidy Scheme (HSS) assists children, the elderly and the lower- to middle-income Singaporeans with their outpatient haze-related medical treatments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We provided subsidies of more than $3.3 million in 2015 which helped with over 77,000 haze-related attendances.

sections.label: Air purifiers for schools
sections.summary: Two days ago, a MOE colleague outlined providing air purifiers to all primary and secondary schools to enhance schoolchildren's well-being.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Two days ago, my colleague from MOE outlined the move to provide air purifiers to all primary and secondary schools to further enhance the well-being of our schoolchildren.

sections.label: ASEAN haze agreement and monitoring
sections.summary: The ASEAN Agreement on Transboundary Haze Pollution is the key framework for collective action, and Singapore led the ASEAN Haze Monitoring System.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The ASEAN Agreement on Transboundary Haze Pollution is the key framework for ASEAN Member States to work collectively and take concerted action against haze.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Singapore has also led the development of the ASEAN Haze Monitoring System which would help to increase transparency and accountability of errant companies that are responsible for the forest fires.
